question: International Tiger Day is observed on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** International Tiger Day is observed on July 29th every year.**
 
• This day is also known as Global Tiger Day and was first created in **2010 at the St. Petersburg Tiger Summit,** which was held to raise awareness about the declining population of wild tigers.
 
• The goal of International Tiger Day is to promote the protection and conservation of tigers and their natural habitats, as well as to raise awareness about the threats that tigers face, such as habitat loss, poaching, and climate change.
